name: brain_search
description: Search the user's brain inbox for previously captured thoughts, notes, or ideas. Use when the user asks "what did I say about X?", "do I have any notes on Y?", or wants to recall something they captured earlier. Returns up to 5 matching entries with their capture text and date.

query.description: Substring to search for in captured text (case-insensitive). Use the most distinctive keyword the user mentioned.
